name: Hanabi
source:
Game focuses on imouto Noemi Ito who did not get own route in the original game. She is a kind and tender sibling who develops feelings for her brother as she observes his infatuations.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作以伊藤诺埃米为主角。她是主人公温柔体贴的妹妹，在原作中没有属于自己的个人路线。眼看哥哥一次次为其他女孩倾心，她也渐渐对他萌生了超越兄妹的感情。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
